credits_note: Credits charged per suggestion. Tool default, admin editable. This is a usage count, not a price. The monthly credit limit per plan lives in config/plans.json and is null until Ali sets it.
note: AI copy prompts for Listing Photos Generator. Prompts are admin editable, versioned, changeable without code changes. Each prompt carries a version, a preview, and a rollback target. Limits (title length, tag count, tag length) are supplied with each request from the active platform pack, never written into the prompt text as fixed numbers. No prompt may ask for an invented product fact.

prompts.change_note: First version. Uses only verified product facts, asks for missing information, never invents a fact.
prompts.preview: Title from product name, format, and confirmed tab count only, within the platform title limit supplied with the request. Prompt: [product name], [format], [tab count]
prompts.prompt_text: Write one listing title using only the verified product facts supplied with this request: the product name, the format, and the tab count when it is confirmed. Keep the title within the platform title limit supplied with the request. Do not add a price, shipping information, or sales information to the title. Do not add a tab count, a format, a feature, a price, a review, or a claim that is not in the verified facts. If the product name or the format is missing, say what is missing instead of inventing it.

prompts.change_note: First version. Description from verified facts only, keywords in the first sentences, no copied title.
prompts.preview: Description from product name, format, confirmed tab count, and confirmed features only. Prompt: [product name], [format], [tab count], [features]
prompts.prompt_text: Write a listing description using only the verified product facts supplied with this request: the product name, the format, the tab count when it is confirmed, the features, and the claims. Put the most relevant keywords in the first few sentences. Do not copy the title word for word. Do not add a tab count, a format, a feature, a price, a review, or a claim that is not in the verified facts. Do not describe a Sheets product as an Excel product. If a fact is missing, say what is missing instead of inventing it.

prompts.change_note: First version. Tags from the seller's own product words only.
prompts.preview: Tags built from the seller's own product words only, within the platform tag count and tag length supplied with the request. Prompt: [seller product words]
prompts.prompt_text: Write listing tags using only the seller's own product words supplied with this request: words from the product name, the features, and the claims. Use the platform tag count and tag length supplied with the request. Each tag must be a short descriptive phrase in natural language. Do not add a word that states a format, a tab count, a price, a review, or a use the product does not have. If there are not enough of the seller's own words to fill the tag count, return fewer tags instead of inventing words.

prompts.change_note: First version. Checklist wording from verified facts only.
prompts.preview: Pre publish checklist from verified facts only. Prompt: [tab count], [format], [features]
prompts.prompt_text: Write a pre publish checklist using only the verified product facts supplied with this request. Each item must check one fact against the real product: the title, the tab count when it is confirmed, the format, and every feature listed. Write each item in plain words, as a check the seller can do before export. Do not add a check for a fact the seller has not confirmed.

prompts.change_note: First version. Niche tailoring highlights confirmed features only, never adds a feature.
prompts.preview: Niche tailoring with the pack tone guidance, using only confirmed features. Prompt: [niche tone], [confirmed features]
prompts.prompt_text: Tailor the supplied suggestion for the niche pack using only the seller's confirmed product facts and the pack tone guidance supplied with this request. Highlight the features that are relevant to this niche and that the product really has. Do not add a feature, a tab count, a format, a price, or a claim the seller does not have. Do not copy the tone or the template order of another niche pack. If the niche pack is not ready for AI generation, do not tailor anything.

provider.note: AI provider choice and budget cap are open decisions for Ali. Null means not decided, never an invented provider or price. No real provider call is made until he chooses one.
